title: The 6 Best Blackout Curtains for Shift Workers
h1: The 6 Best Blackout Curtains for Shift Workers
metaDescription: Our 6 picks for blackout curtains for shift workers, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at blackout curtains for shift workers using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Eclipse Palisade Blackout Curtain Panel
products.blurb: Key specs: 52 x 84 inch single panel, grommet top, Thermaback triple-weave blackout backing, Blocks 98% to 99.9% of light.
strengths: Thermaback backing blocks nearly all direct light through the fabric itself
Sold per panel so a wide window can be covered exactly without buying an oversized pair
Noticeably dims a bedroom even against strong midday sun
limitations: Sold as a single panel, so covering a standard window with two panels costs double the sticker price
Stiffer hand-feel than fabric-only blackout curtains
features: 52 x 84 inch single panel, grommet top
Reduces outside noise and insulates against heat and cold

products.name: Lush Decor Insulated Grommet Blackout Curtain Panel Pair
products.blurb: Key specs: 52 x 84 inch pair, 2 panels, Microfiber fabric with built-in insulation, no separate liner needed, 1.65 inch metal grommets.
strengths: Sold as a pair, so a single order covers a standard window with overlap
Microfiber fabric feels softer than stiffer single-layer blackout panels
Darker colorways block close to full light for daytime sleep
limitations: Lighter colorways block noticeably less light than the darker options
Some buyers report a factory odor on first unboxing that airs out after a wash
features: Microfiber fabric with built-in insulation, no separate liner needed
Blocks approximately 95% to 99% of light depending on color

products.name: Sun Zero Easton Blackout Grommet Curtain Panel
products.blurb: Key specs: 40 x 63 inch single panel, grommet top, Blocks up to 90% of light, Reduces energy loss through the window by up to 25%.
strengths: Easy to buy multiples to layer over a wide window
limitations: 90% light blocking is noticeably less complete than the Eclipse or Lush Decor options
40-inch width means most windows need 3 panels rather than 2 for full coverage
features: 40 x 63 inch single panel, grommet top
Reduces energy loss through the window by up to 25%

products.name: Exclusive Home Curtains Gates Sateen Blackout Curtain Panel Pair
products.blurb: Key specs: 52 x 63 inch pair, 2 panels, 8 matte silver grommets per panel, Sateen twill weave with Light Block and Thermax lining.
strengths: Sateen finish has a more polished look than a matte blackout panel
Thermax lining adds genuine thermal insulation, useful for daytime heat buildup
8 grommets per panel glide smoothly on the rod
limitations: 63-inch length is short for a floor-length look on standard 8-foot ceilings
Fewer total ratings than the Eclipse or Sun Zero lines
features: Sateen twill weave with Light Block and Thermax lining
Blocks light and blocks harmful UV rays

products.name: Eclipse Darrell Rod Pocket Blackout Curtain Panel
products.blurb: Key specs: 37 x 84 inch single panel, rod pocket top, Thermaback blackout backing, Blocks over 99% of light.
strengths: 99% light blocking matches the Palisade despite the narrower width
37-inch width is a better proportional fit for narrow bedroom windows
Rod pocket top gives a cleaner, more traditional look than grommets
limitations: Rod pocket top is slower to open and close than a grommet panel
Narrower width means more panels are needed for a wide window
features: 37 x 84 inch single panel, rod pocket top
Reduces noise and insulates against heat and cold

products.name: NICETOWN Thermal Insulated 100% Blackout Curtains
limitations: Light still leaks around edges without wraparound rods
Liner side faces the window only

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
